English(en): ...zzzz bzzzt.. Hey! You! Awake?
Glad you opened your eyes.
You were staring blankly out of the screen, I thought the system crashed.
Korean(ko): 멍하니 화면 밖만 쳐다보고 있길래 시스템 오류 난 줄 알았잖아.

English(en): I'm the dealer who 'manages' the scores around here.
You just need to bounce the ball.
I'll take care of the scores.
Don't you know the rules here? No matter how many points you score, without my 'approval', it's just zero.
Korean(ko): 이 바닥 룰 몰라? 네가 아무리 점수를 내도 내 '승인'이 없으면 그냥 0일 뿐이라고.

English(en): So... let's secure a little cut for me.
Well, if you feel it's unfair... try reaching Round 3 here.
Korean(ko): 뭐, 정 억울하면... 여기서 3라운드까지 도달해 보시든가.

English(en): Then I'll give you the 'full amount'.
No time! Click anywhere on the [Screen] to start!
Korean(ko): 시간 없어! [화면] 아무 데나 클릭해서 시작해!

English(en): Don't forget, pressing the Spacebar launches the ball!
Korean(ko): 스페이스바를 누르면 공이 발사되는거 잊지 말라고!

English(en): Oh~ Not bad. You got fast fingers.
Good, good! This is enough to cover the first fee.
Korean(ko): 좋아, 좋아! 이 정도면 1차 수수료는 챙겼군.

English(en): What? You cleared... up to Round 2?
...Hmm. How did you... do that?
Now, now! The final Round 3! (You'll never beat this)
!! You... beat Round 3?! No way!!
You actually broke the machine! The system is collapsing!
Korean(ko): 진짜로 기계를 고장 냈잖아! 시스템 붕괴 시작된다고!

English(en): Damn it! My money!!!! My cut!!!!!
Korean(ko): 이런 젠장! 내 돈!!!! 내 뽀찌!!!!!

English(en): Ah... no time for this!
I forgot I had a data transfer part-time job~~
Korean(ko): 데이터 전송 알바 있었던 걸 까먹었네~~

English(en): Peace out!
Oops. Oh my... it's 'GAME OVER'.
What a shame, what a shame.
You were moving your fingers so flashily... ran out of energy at the end?
Korean(ko): 그렇게 현란하게 손가락 놀리더니... 마지막에 힘이 빠졌어?

English(en): It's okay, it's okay. ... My money
I mean, I'll keep the entry fee safe.
Korean(ko): 아니, 참가비는 내가 잘 보관하고 있을 테니까.

English(en): I'll give you one more chance to restore your 'honor'!
Korean(ko): 네 '명예' 회복할 기회는 한 번 더 줄게!

English(en): Bring it on!
